wallMaterials.scheme: C / 云绿与干邑 / MOSS & COGNAC
wallMaterials.scope: Two real wall finishes researched on manufacturer websites. Design application is a proposal, not an as-built specification. No website or VR files changed.
wallMaterials.design_direction_zh: 墙面以平滑暖灰米为主，只在挂画背板与局部窗洞收口加入整面、竖纹、低光泽烟熏胡桃木。与相邻酒红屏风、镜花墙及黑石地面衔接；不加木格栅、额外几何拼花、洞石或毛绒材料。

materials.specified_execution: Shinnoki Laminates, thin real-wood veneer finish; not the rigid prefinished MDF panel execution.
verified_facts: The laminate execution is a stained and lacquered wood veneer on phenolic-resin-impregnated paper; the manufacturer describes it for alternative substrates and rounded elements.
The technical sheet gives 3050 × 1220 × 1 mm: 0.6 mm veneer plus 0.4 mm backing.
The separate finished panel product uses an MDF core; this is not evidence that a rigid MDF panel can be directly bent.
curved_wall_limitations_zh: 作为表面饰材粘贴在按现场弧度制作的稳定弧面基层上；不是无需基层的自承重弯板。基层体系、胶黏剂、平衡背衬及接缝做法需由材料商和木作厂针对该执行版本确认。
官方技术表弯曲半径一栏写成 Maximum 150 mm，语义不清；本方案不据此声称最小弯曲半径。落地前按实际圆厅曲率与纹理方向做足尺样板，并向厂家取得明确的适用半径和胶合工艺。
官网当前下载页的部分 laminate processing/gluing 链接打开后标题为 Decolam，且叙述未饰面的木皮，不宜直接当成 Shinnoki 预饰面胶合规范使用。
materials.proposed_use_zh: 建议局部全高挂画背板，竖向连续木纹、宽幅平板与克制细缝；其余弧墙保持浅色。具体分幅与收口由现场测量决定。
materials.colour_comment_zh: 官方小样为温暖棕色胡桃木，暗而不发乌；与原款焦糖椅、古铜茶几及酒红吊灯连接。此为搭配判断，屏幕图不能保证实物色。

image.use_limit: Small colour/grain reference only; not a seamless scan or a guaranteed full-panel match. Do not label this as client-site photography.

verified_facts: Bone is described by the manufacturer as a warm neutral with no or very low texture, depending on the surface and lighting; it can appear greyer in some light.
The product page offers sample pots and paint ordering. An in-situ sample is necessary for final colour selection.

For new plasterboard the surface guide specifies two coats of suitable water-based undercoat-sealer/primer, one Bauwerk Prep Coat and two limewash coats; already correctly primed, unrepaired walls may not need the initial priming step.
substrate_limitations_zh: 弧面造型由墙体基层形成，涂料本身不承担弯板功能。新或修补的石膏板需要统一吸收率，防止接缝、补丁透显；Prep Coat 不是底漆的替代品。
平整度影响最终表面；本方案要求细找平、低起伏的薄涂效果，先按官方工艺在实际或同材质基层打样。不要将其表现成粗糙砂岩、洞石或厚重云斑。
materials.proposed_use_zh: 作为大面积连续浅色墙面，保留画作和石壁灯的留白，使云绿、焦糖、古铜与相邻黑石地面有统一的暖中性背景。
materials.colour_comment_zh: 建议暖灰米而非冷水泥灰；数字效果图只作近似色感，以现场日光和暖光下的实物样板为准。
